1. (Currently Amended) A dynamic laminar structure, for example for working tools and machines, comprising a lamination of at least two layers and an internal layer, wherein the internal layer is a combination of two or more components, __wherein the lamination includes a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer on opposite sides of the internal layer, and wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are each formed from a material selected from the group consisting of epoxy, polyurethane, and phenolic adhesives__.

2. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 wherein the internal layer comprises __at least one of the following: a honeycomb structure, a metal plate, a fiber reinforced plastic material, or a combination thereof__.

3. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 wherein the internal layer comprises a honeycomb structure __bonded to fiber reinforced plastic material on at least one side of the honeycomb structure__.

4. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 wherein the lamination comprises first and second outer layers and __wherein the first and second outer layers are each formed from a material selected from the group consisting of metal, plastic, and fiber reinforced plastic__.

5. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 further comprising __a weld ring at least partially interposed between an outer perimeter of the first and second layers and a plurality of cutting segments, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the internal layer__.

6. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285 wherein __the plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring__.

7. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285 wherein __the weld ring is continuous around the outer perimeter__.

8. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285 wherein __the lamination has a circular shape and the plurality of cutting segments are arc-shaped segments affixed to the outer perimeter__.

9. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285 further comprising __an inner ring coupled to an inner perimeter of the internal layer, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft__.

10. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 289 wherein __the inner ring is bonded to the internal layer__.

11. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 further comprising __a weld ring at least partially interposed between an outer perimeter of the first and second layers and a plurality of cutting segments, wherein the weld ring is segmented and the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the segmented weld ring__.

12. (Currently Amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 293 wherein __the segmented weld ring includes a plurality of separate ring segments__.
